items.title: Summer Camp at the National Museum: Summer Wonders
items.content_text: Summer Wonders is the National Museum's summer program, offering interactive learning experiences for children and families through creative workshops, storytelling, games, hands-on activities, and live musical performances. The program encourages participants to explore history, culture, design, and technology through engaging activities that inspire creativity and discovery. Visitors can enjoy a variety of experiences, including family challenges, interactive exhibitions, craft workshops, shadow storytelling, educational games, and music evenings. Program Highlights Interactive family activities and storytelling experiences. Creative workshops for all ages. Educational games and hands-on learning. Musical performances every Friday. Interactive installations and museum exploration activities. Design, creativity, and technology experiences. Workshops Creative workshops are held every Thursday and Friday at The Studio, with multiple sessions available throughout the day. Activities are suitable for all ages. Register Now Visiting Hours Saturday–Wednesday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM Thursday: 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM Friday: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM Sunday: Closed

items.title: Mishkat Summer Camp
items.content_text: Discover the exciting world of science, energy, and innovation at Mishkat Summer Camp 2026, where young learners can explore the future through hands-on experiments, interactive challenges, educational games, and collaborative activities designed to inspire curiosity, creativity, and teamwork. Organised by Mishkat Interactive Center, an initiative of the King Abdullah City for Atomic and Renewable Energy (K.A.CARE), the camp introduces participants to the future of energy while developing STEAM skills through experiential learning. Activities explore topics such as solar, wind, and nuclear energy, hydrogen technologies, the circular carbon economy, artificial intelligence, innovation, and programming, supporting Saudi Vision 2030's goals of building future-ready generations. The programme is free of charge and is open to children aged 10–12 years. Camp Schedule Girls: 12–23 July | Boys: 26 July–6 August | Days: Sunday–Thursday Register Now

items.title: Summer Fruits Season in AlUla

items.title: Wrth Summer Art & Craft Program
items.content_text: Introduce your children to the richness of Saudi Arabia's traditional arts at the Wrth Summer Art & Craft Program 2026, organized by the Royal Institute of Traditional Arts (Wrth). Taking place at Riyadh Park from 16 to 18 July 2026, the program offers children aged 8–12 an enriching summer experience through a sensory, hands-on journey exploring the traditional arts of the Kingdom's diverse regions. Through a variety of interactive activity stations, children will discover heritage-inspired crafts including pottery, Al Sadu weaving, traditional incense burner (mabkharah) making, Najdi door decoration, and other traditional art forms. Designed to nurture creativity, develop practical skills, and deepen appreciation for Saudi culture, the program provides an engaging environment where young learners can explore, create, and connect with the Kingdom's rich artistic heritage. Book Now

items.title: Saudi International Falcons & Hunting Exhibition
items.content_text: The Saudi International Falcons and Hunting Exhibition is one of the largest events dedicated to falconry and hunting in Saudi and globally. It brings together everything related to falconry and outdoor excursions, from falcons and hunting tools to equipment and gear associated with hunting trips, all within a comprehensive space that allows visitors to explore this field in one place. The exhibition also features platforms showcasing a wide range of brands, alongside accompanying activities and events suitable for families, creating an experience that blends cultural and entertainment elements. The event plays an important role in preserving falconry heritage and raising awareness by offering content that introduces visitors to its history and significance within Saudi’s cultural identity.

items.title: Saudi Falcons Club Auction
items.content_text: The Saudi Falcons Club organizes an annual auction dedicated to locally caught falcons, known as “Al Tarh falcons,” which are captured during the hunting season. The auction is a structured platform that brings falconers together to showcase their falcons in a competitive live bidding environment, enabling reliable buying and selling. The event is broadcast on television channels and digital platforms. The club also provides integrated services for falcon owners, including transportation to the auction venue, along with facilities that organize and enhance the participation experience, all within a framework aimed at developing falcon auctions in Saudi. The auction also contributes to raising awareness about preserving falcon breeds by regulating sales and emphasizing the protection of endangered species.

Eid Al-Adha ضمن ترفيه وعائلات في على مستوى المملكة. تبدأ الفعالية ٠٦‏/٠٦‏/٢٠٢٧، ٩:٠٠ ص وتنتهي ١٠‏/٠٦‏/٢٠٢٧، ٦:٠٠ م حسب البيانات المتاحة. تعرض الصفحة وقت الفعالية وموقعها ومصدرها وروابط التقويم والاتجاهات عند توفرها. المصدر: Visit Saudi Calendar.
